```{r setup-child, child = "helpers/_setup.Rmd"}
```

```{r}
#| label: library
#| include: false
options(housepi.footer.sample = TRUE)
library(housepi)
housepi_theme_set()
set.seed(42)
```

Contact rates allow modelling differential transmission between groups of individuals within a household.
Unlike group rates, which apply to a single individual, contact rates define pairwise from/to relationships.
We illustrate the API using the Matsumoto influenza household survey.

# Load model and data

We start by loading the heterogeneous chain binomial model and the `flu_2014_matsumoto` dataset.
This dataset contains household reports of influenza episodes with a `member` column distinguishing "Student" from "Other" household members.

```{r}
#| label: load-model-data
hhmodel <- new_housepi_model("chain_binomial_heterogeneous") |>
  load_parameter_template() |>
  add_data_wide(flu_2014_matsumoto)

# inspect the data
head(flu_2014_matsumoto)
```

# Define a contact rate

Use `add_contact_rate()` to define pairwise transmission rates based on a categorical feature.
This creates from/to parameter pairs for each combination of groups.

```{r}
#| label: add-contact-rate
hhmodel |>
  add_contact_rate(by = "member") |>
  get_contact_rates()
```

Each row in the output represents a directed from/to pair.
The `param_name` column gives the corresponding parameter that will scale the transmission rate between those groups.
The `.reference` pair (by default the most frequent combination) is fixed at 1.

# Custom reference

Provide a `reference` to select which from/to pair acts as the baseline:

```{r}
#| label: custom-reference
hhmodel |>
  add_contact_rate(by = "member",
                   reference = c(from_member = "Other",
                                 to_member = "Other")) |>
  get_contact_rates()
```

A convenience shorthand applies the same reference value to both from and to:

```{r}
#| label: shorthand-reference
hhmodel |>
  add_contact_rate(by = "member",
                   reference = c(member = "Student")) |>
  get_contact_rates()
```

# Parameters associated to contact rates

Parameters generated by the contact rate follow the same MCMC defaults as group rates (lognormal prior and proposal).
Customise them at definition time:

```{r}
#| label: contact-rate-parameters
hhmodel |>
  add_contact_rate(by = "member", prefix = "cr", prior = "normal") |>
  get_parameters()
```

# Drop contact rates

To remove a contact rate definition, call `drop_contact_rates()`:

```{r}
#| label: drop-contact-rates
hhmodel |>
  add_contact_rate(by = "member") |>
  drop_contact_rates() |>
  get_contact_rates()
```
